products.title: Bose QuietComfort Ultra Headphones (2nd Gen)
products.description: Experience immersive, personalized sound with the Bose QuietComfort Ultra headphones. Featuring breakthrough spatial audio, these wireless headphones create a natural, live-sounding music experience by placing audio in front of you. CustomTune technology analyzes your ear's unique shape to adapt the audio performance for a perfect fit. Crafted with premium materials, including soft ear cushions and an evenly distributing headband, these headphones offer refined comfort. Sleek metal arms add a statement of sophisticated design. Connect seamlessly with advanced Bluetooth 5.3 and manage devices, settings, and features like Adjustable EQ via the Bose app. Enjoy crystal-clear calls with noise-rejecting microphones that focus on your voice.

products.title: Bose Quietcomfort Ultra Headphones
products.description: Experience immersive audio with the Bose QuietComfort Ultra Headphones (2nd Gen). These wireless over-ear headphones offer advanced noise cancellation, improved echo reduction, and crystal-clear sound for music, calls, and podcasts. Designed for all-day comfort with plush protein leather ear cushions and an adjustable headband, they are ideal for music lovers, commuters, and professionals. Featuring Bluetooth 5.4 for seamless connectivity up to 30 feet, they also offer a wired option with an included audio cable and USB-C lossless audio. Intuitive on-ear controls, capacitive touch strip for volume, and on-head detection enhance the user experience. The Bose Music App allows for personalized settings, custom modes, and adjustable EQ. With up to 30 hours of playtime, a protective carry case, and travel-friendly accessories, these headphones combine style, performance, and innovation.

products.title: Bose QuietComfort Ultra Headphones
products.description: The Bose QuietComfort Ultra Headphones in Sandstone are premium over-ear wireless headphones designed for an immersive audio experience. They feature world-class noise cancellation and breakthrough spatialized audio (Bose Immersive Audio) that creates a natural soundstage. Equipped with CustomTune technology, they adapt audio performance to the unique shape of the user's ear. These headphones offer up to 24 hours of battery life, advanced Bluetooth 5.3 connectivity, and a high-quality microphone system for clear calls. This specific bundle includes a Green Extreme Portable Wireless Charger.

products.title: Bose QuietComfort Ultra Headphones (2nd Gen)
products.description: The Bose QuietComfort Ultra Headphones (2nd Gen) in Olive Green are premium wireless over-ear headphones featuring world-class active noise cancellation and Bose Immersive Audio for a spacious, lifelike sound experience. They utilize CustomTune technology to personalize audio based on the user's ear shape and offer up to 30 hours of battery life. Designed for comfort and portability, they feature soft protein leather ear cushions, a foldable design, and Bluetooth 5.4 connectivity.
